title: Canonical Boolean-scanning machine
statement: For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and tape index $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(k)$, this is a $k$-work-tape Boolean machine with scan states recording a Boolean value. It scans while folding the input bits by replacing the recorded value with each bit read, keeps the work tapes, and starts with recorded value true.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the scan-machine construction or the precise meaning of its keep action, so those operational details cannot be fully rendered.
